sourceLocations: host/dsh/lib/runner.js (runWorker: agents.create -> session identity report -> capability refusal)
src/deployment/work_worker.ts (the parent port and its strict identity parser)
method: boot the CURRENT branch's host bundle in a test-owned DSH home via the SHIPPED worker port, with a test-owned profile that makes the SHIPPED capability refusal fire after session creation and before the first model turn; observe the identity on the real IPC channel

observations.hostFailureDetail: the worker reported an unusable outcome: worker result has unknown argument "detail": (node:44284) ExperimentalWarning: SQLite is an experimental feature and might change at any time | (Use `node --trace-warnings ...` to show where the warning was created)

corroboratingRun.note: a second boot spawned directly with the SAME argv and stdio shape the port uses; it shows the worker's OWN telemetry and the refusal reason, proving the refusal fired rather than the worker dying for an unrelated reason
corroboratingRun.workerResult: {"kind":"HOST_FAILURE","detail":"refusing to run this worker: UNCLASSIFIED worker-visible capability(ies): p2a_refusal_probe — an unknown capability is not assumed safe, so the worker must not start"}

expectedInvariant: a real DSH session is created, its identity reaches the parent on the IPC channel, the parent stamps its own invocation, the worker is refused, and NO model turn runs

noModelProof.structuralExclusion: the runner's capability refusal is thrown between `agents.create` and the only `agent.followup` call; on a refusal the runner disposes the handle and never reaches the first turn

runtimeMeasurement.note: a model turn appends turn/start and request/header events to the session artifact; zero such events is the measurement, not the assumption

testProfileProvenance: a test-owned DSH home under the gate root, with a test-owned profile that mounts the current branch's host bundle; no user profile is loaded and no credential is copied
remainingUncertainty: the refusal is the SHIPPED fail-closed path, made deterministic by a test-owned unclassified probe tool; a production worker would be ADMITTED and then run a model turn, which is out of P2-A scope
the identity observation is not a durable binding: nothing here persists an Attempt -> Session association
whatItProves: a real first-party DSH Agent Session was created (a session artifact exists under the test-owned home)
the SessionId the Parent observed equals a session the Host actually wrote
the identity travelled on the Direct Child IPC channel and the Parent stamped its OWN wpi- invocation
the capability refusal is the SHIPPED fail-closed path (corroborated by the worker own result line)
zero turn/request events exist in the written session: no model turn ran
whatItDoesNotProve: that a model turn would succeed
that the session belongs to a verified association
